heading: The people behind the parcels
intro: Eleven of us in Portland, and 38 makers we work with directly.

people.name: Ingrid Solberg
people.bio: Started Northwind on a market stall in 2014 and still chooses every piece we stock.

people.name: Tomás Ferreira
people.bio: Throws about sixty mugs a day. Found our speckled glaze by accident in 2016.

people.name: Aiko Mori
people.bio: Runs the 1960s Dobcross loom and teaches the Saturday weaving class.

people.name: Dele Okafor
people.bio: Answers your emails, sorts your returns and knows where every parcel is.
